ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in Figure 1, it is known that $\angle BOC = 40^\circ$, $OE$ bisects $\angle AOC$, and $OF$ bisects $\angle BOC$. If $AO \perp BO$, then what is the measure of $\angle EOF$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because$ $\angle BOC=40^\circ$ and $AO\perp BO$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle AOB=90^\circ, \angle AOC=\angle AOB+\angle BOC=130^\circ$,\\
$\because$ $OE$ bisects $\angle AOC$ and $OF$ bisects $\angle BOC$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle EOC=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOC=65^\circ, \angle COF=\frac{1}{2}\angle BOC=20^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle EOF=\angle EOC−\angle COF=65^\circ−20^\circ=\boxed{45^\circ}$.
